fields.description: The version of the HGB-Taxonomie whose positions the rules name.
fields.label: HGB Taxonomy

fields.description: The defaults Vorgaben laden or Vorgaben aktualisieren took over last: the chart, the version of the taxonomy, the edition of the DATEV chart and the revision of the defaults of Steuerbote.
fields.label: Defaults Version

fields.description: The rows the defaults gave this mapping when they were taken over last, against which Vorgaben aktualisieren tells the changes of the defaults from your own.
fields.label: Defaults as Taken Over

fields.description: Which account goes to which position of the HGB-Taxonomie: an account of the Bilanz with its balance at the Stichtag, an account of the GuV with its balance of the fiscal year.
fields.label: Account Rules

fields.description: Accounts whose position is not decided yet. A balance on one watched at the level Blocking holds the E-Bilanz and the Jahresabschluss back; on one watched at the level Hint it adds a hint, and the balance goes into no position.
fields.label: Watched Accounts

fields.description: Accounts whose balance goes into neither the Bilanz nor the GuV, each with the reason, such as the Vortrags- and statistical accounts of class 9 of the DATEV charts.
fields.label: Accounts outside the Bilanz and the GuV
